title: Zesty Jamaican Chicken Fried Rice
description: A malty and chewy quick-fix Jamaican dish featuring onions and double-fry KFC style chicken, egg-free friendly and perfect for a lazy Susan spinner vessel. It is a flavorful and spicy meal that can be prepared in no time.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the allspice, thyme, scotch bonnet pepper, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir-fry the rice mixture for about 5 minutes, until the rice is heated through and starting to brown.
Add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce to the skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Serve the Zesty Jamaican Chicken Fried Rice hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
